entities.summary: Friedrich J. Haberlandt (1826–1878) was a professor of agriculture at the Hochschule fuer Bodenkultur in Vienna, Austria-Hungary. He is best known for his book Die Sojabohne, which introduced soybean cultivation to Western and Central Europe.
